resources.string: The PS2\'s 448 lines times the factor: 8x is beyond 4K. In effect the next time the game opens.
Sharp bilinear and CAS make the 2D crisper; FXAA smooths the edges of the 3D.

50 is the game\'s own rate (25 pictures a second, PAL). 60, 90 and 120 are drawn in between, in fights and in the campaign; menus stay at the game\'s rate. This screen shows up to %1$.0f Hz: above that the extra pictures are not seen, but the device still draws them (useful to measure).
Attack. Taps in a row make the combo; with a direction, other moves.
Chakra. Hold to fill the blue bar.
Awakening: on low health, some characters transform.
Jutsu: △ then ○, in one tap (uses chakra).
Ultimate jutsu (Ougi): △ △ ○ in one tap, up close: the ○ strike must land for the film to start. In its film, tap the button the game asks for.
One tap of the special button does the Jutsu or the Ougi depending on the chakra, and answers the buttons the game asks for on screen.
Clashes and press-repeatedly scenes: each tap is worth
At 200%, each tap counts as two presses.
Stick: put your finger anywhere on the left half.
The game\'s SELECT, at the top of the screen.
Slide: moves the cursor. Hold away to repeat.
Two fingers sliding sideways: L1 / R1.
Three fingers: START (START is also at the top).
A physical controller works alongside: while it is used, the on-screen buttons hide until the screen is touched again.
Automatic: buttons in fights and in the campaign, gestures in menus, hidden while a physical controller is used.
